subject: Capacity window pick — Dedicated demo coordination for CloudWave
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@cloudwave.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Demo booked via self-signup — CloudWave (Dedicated capacity)

Hi Karthik / Ben,

Thanks — I just booked a 60-minute demo via your public scheduler (got confirmation for Aug 19, 11:00 AM ET). We listed that we need Dedicated capacity for inference (real-time chat surface) and put some high-level numbers in the form, but I wanted to share a quick note with expected traffic so you have context before the walkthrough: 

- Peak steady QPS: ~420 qps
- Typical request payload: 350 tokens
- P95 latency requirement: <= 180ms per token (for token generation tail)
- Multi-region failover desired (primary: us-east)

I can attach our perf brief and a sample request if it helps. Would you prefer a short calibration call beforehand (15m) to ensure the demo uses a relevant load profile?

Best,
Alyssa
Senior Product Manager — CloudWave

Attachment: cloudwave_perf_requirements.pdf (pdf stub)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@cloudwave.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo booked via self-signup — CloudWave (Dedicated capacity)

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the details and the perf brief.

Yes — a brief 15-minute calibration before the 60-minute demo would be ideal. Goal: validate the workload shape (burstiness and token lengths) so we pick the right Dedicated slot and prepare a representative run. Proposed options (all ET):
- Thu Aug 19, 10:15–10:30 (right before the demo)
- Thu Aug 19, 09:00–09:15 (if you want more lead time)
- Wed Aug 18, 16:00–16:15 (today, if that works)

Ben — can you reserve a dedicated capacity test window and share the calendar invite for whichever Alyssa picks? Priyom, I'd like you on the calibration call to confirm quantization/profile choices if we need to simulate 400+ qps.

Also attaching a tiny sample payload we use to sanity-check requests: sample_workload.json (stub).

— Karthik
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: sample_workload.json (json stub)

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo booked via self-signup — CloudWave (Dedicated capacity)

Hi Alyssa — I can hold a dedicated test slot. Two quick logistics notes: 

1) We typically recommend a 90-minute reserved window for first-time Dedicated demos (30m calibration + 60m demo) so we can run a short sustained-load check if needed. If you want to keep to 60m, we can still do calibration beforehand.
2) Our reserved pools sometimes need a quiet window; if your preferred time overlaps high-traffic slots in our region we may move by +/- 1 hour. I can offer the following concrete windows (ET):
   • Thu Aug 19, 10:00–11:30 (preferred — leaves room for a short smoke test)
   • Thu Aug 19, 12:00–13:30 (backup)
   • Fri Aug 20, 09:00–10:30 (alternate)

Pick a slot and I will send an invite with a link to a temporary test endpoint and a short runbook. Calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/karthik/availability?slot=2027-08-19T15:00

Thanks — Ben
SDR, Redwood Inference

Note: reserving a dedicated slot may require a short capacity commit for the hour; we will confirm before finalizing.

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@cloudwave.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 08:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo booked via self-signup — CloudWave (Dedicated capacity)

Thanks, Ben — can we shift the demo up one day to Wed Aug 19 11:00 AM ET? (I realize your examples used Thu; our schedule opened up.) If that creates a conflict, the 10:00–11:30 window you offered would work and we can do the 15-minute calibration at 09:45 ET.

To confirm workload: CloudWave expects 350–500 qps during peak bursts, with average payloads ~320 tokens and occasional long sequences up to 800 tokens for batch summarization tests. The p95 generation latency target is 180ms/token but we can accept a slightly higher tail if you can show mitigation strategies (KV caching, prioritized batches).

I attached our short perf brief and a sample of anonymized requests. Also — please send the pre-demo checklist (IP allowlist, test endpoint, any secrets needed).

— Alyssa

Attachment: cloudwave_perf_requirements.pdf (updated)

Hi Alyssa — confirmed Wed Aug 19, 11:00 AM ET (90-minute reserved window starting 10:30 for a 15m calibration + 60m demo + 15m Q&A). Calendar invite sent from Redwood Calendars.

Pre-demo checklist (short):
- Please add allowlist entries for: 34.216.12.45, 34.216.12.46 (temporary test endpoints)
- We will provide a temporary API key (valid 24h) — expect it via a secure Doc link 1 hour before the test
- Share a small representative corpus (anonymized) — capacity_matrix.csv is useful to predict batch mixing
- If you want regional failover testing, let us know two target regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west)

I've attached a short runbook and a stub capacity matrix we can fill out together during calibration. Priyom will join to validate quantization profiles and to note which model variants we'll exercise during the demo.

See you tomorrow — Neha
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
